renderPacket.identity: Ala-Too Square in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan: the broad civic square and recognizable central public architecture, with the snowy Kyrgyz Ala-Too range visible beyond the low-rise city on a clear day; a real Bishkek urban view, not a generic Central Asian plaza.

Burana Tower near Tokmok in Kyrgyzstan: the recognizable tapered cylindrical baked-brick minaret standing alone in open Chuy Valley grassland, with low archaeological remains and the Tien Shan foothills/mountains in the distance; historically grounded Balasagun setting.
